meals.note: Gets Majide to Support 2 before Renown 5. No Fianna yet: Cai + Mikaela + Seteth. Majide done: Cai + Mikaela + Ninae.
Whoever reaches Support 3 hands their seat to Fianna or Sirocco. No Sirocco yet: Cai + Fianna + the lowest of Seteth, Ninae and Mikaela.

gifts.gift: Tales of Adventure, if you reach Saveilon this chapter

missables.text: Finish [[quest:lost-temple-cat]] by 5/20: find the cat at the fountain
Recruit Noctula the day Renown 4 lands: the plan skips [[item:Ursa's Right Claw]]
detail: The Claw only comes with a Lv 20+ Pugilist recruit, a Ch 10+ join.
Waiting would cost her the Ch 6 to 9 maps. Already recruited? Nothing to do.
missables.recover: None: it only comes with a late recruit

missables.text: Watch the optional mural scene at Ahm Lu before you go to the story marker

note.text: The Blacksmith opens: refine each unit's one refine project instead of buying new iron weapons
detail: No Levin Sword by Ch 9? Skip the barter: the Ch 10 map has one, and a Ch 10+ Nuzzuo, Io or Jester brings another.

recruits.action: Talk to her the day Renown 4 lands: no item or quest needed
detail: She joins at about Lv 15 in a Beginner class.
Her Ch 8 Brigand side trip needs Axe C and Sword C, so let her fight with both.

recruits.action: Answer his question each time you talk: he accepts on the third answer
recruits.when: Very end of Ch 6 or Ch 7 (Renown 5)

recruits.action: Pay the 3,000G fee once Support 3 and Renown 5 are both reached
detail: Part II extra: she goes to the bench at about Lv 15 in a Beginner class.
Her Part II Archer and Forest Knight exams need Bow B and Rider D.

prep.text: Keep Seteth and Ninae's Support rising: they join at Renown 6, late Ch 7 at best
Get Ninae's 1× [[gather:Paradise Fish]] at [[place:Lake Brontes]] (Saveilon) if you can reach it
detail: Can't reach Saveilon yet? Get it in Ch 7, or on Castor's Saveilon trip (Renown 7, late Ch 8).

route.note: Renown 4: the [[item:Healing Staff]] goes to Tialla
Plant 30 Linaria, not 20: the extra 10 pay Ninae's Hexlock Shield
Deliver the day the crops are ready, not on 11/27: it pulls Renown 8 into early Ch 10

sub.note: Ch 7's free time starts 6/9, so finish it now. Keep some Jyoppa for A Taste from Home (Ch 7)
First playthrough only: take it when the Blacksmith opens
Heretics' Cave has one Sandworm on Cai's route; it can wait for early Ch 7

explore.text: Plant now (Farming, Cai only): 30 Linaria and 30 Coffee Berries, Zang or Pongo, plus 10 extra Pongo
detail: The 10 extra Pongo pay Archive T for Ultand (Pongo ×10 + Glirmosa ×4).
Crops also pay Vandahl barters in Dagsion Port.

explore.text: Watch the Farming tutorial (Cai only) if you haven't planted yet

explore.group: Spare Turns · gather for Vandahl barters (Dagsion Port), nearest first
Spare Turns · gather for Vandahl barters (Dagsion Port), nearest first

explore.text: Run [[place:Dione Fort]] (Lv 18, Castalia) with this week's meal pairs
Clear the Temple of Balor dungeon: [[item:Lashing Rapture]] and an [[item:Elixir]]

tips.text: Stay grouped, go clockwise and fight from high-evasion terrain
